scope_deferrals.title: Discount semantics inconsistency between Web and API
scope_deferrals.details: OrderService recalculates Total using Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount) (0..1 fraction), while OrderDetailState.CalculateLineTotal in the Web uses Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 - Discount / 100m) (percentage). Pre-existing since the initial rebuild. Candidate spec slug: order-discount-semantics-alignment. Carried forward from Session 5 disposition.

scope_deferrals.title: W2 runner SeededSignInAsync / DSL login conflict (option-a)
scope_deferrals.details: Compiled UAT tests that include full sign-in flow in DSL Steps[] conflict with the W2 runner's auto-inserted SeededSignInAsync wrapper. Documented as option-a per project-guidance.md; W2 correctness proof is the existing Playwright tests. Resolution requires W2 runner enhancement (opt-out flag or auto-detect DSL login). Applies to composable-crud-helpers compiled test and any future set that authors full-login-flow checklists.
